text: The General Manager, Transportation Services, is seeking City Council approval to decommission all of the 176 on-street single-space meters which are currently located in various Wards across the City of Toronto and accordingly delete all entries in Schedule III, Parking Meters, of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 910, Parking Machines, Parking Meters and Mobile Only Zones. Transportation Services is making this proposal after consulting with the Toronto Parking Authority with respect to the Toronto Parking Authority's experience with the City's on-street single-space meter paid parking program. Single-space meters have been in operation for a number of decades; however, the equipment is at end-of-life and requires extensive maintenance to continue operation. City Council on December 13, 14, and 15, 2023, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend Schedule III, Parking Meters, of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 910, Parking Machines, Parking Meters and Mobile Only Zones, and Schedule XV, Parking for Restricted Periods, of City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 950, Traffic and Parking, by deleting the entries generally as listed in Attachment 1 to the report (November 15, 2023) from the General Manager, Transportation Services, once alternate payment systems, including mobile payment options, are put in place for any locations where parking will continue to be permitted. 2.
